digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, MCP LLM tool descriptions, code-review lifecycle documentation
propositions: Canonical MCP tool descriptions in _mcp_llm.py advertise P1-P9 while production executes P1-P11, causing documentation-implementation drift
Code-review lifecycle comments across review-kernel, prompting, and workflow modules describe stale four-pass gate behavior inconsistent with actual implementation
Generated MCP reference (mcp-reference.md) contains incorrect plan-review pass count (P1-P9) and must be regenerated from corrected source descriptions
JSON schema description fields in plan_review_precheck_output.schema.json and plan_review_verdict.schema.json still advertise retired P1-P9 count instead of implemented P1-P11
Test coverage for canonical descriptions and lifecycle comments is incomplete, missing regression tests to prevent future P1-P9 count reversion
